Remarks

Example usage:

var u = "https://example.com/page".AppendQueryParameter("q","test");
var v = "https://example.com?page=1".RemoveQueryParameter("page");
var mime = "data:image/png;base64,AAA".GetMimeTypeFromDataUri();
